want: a heavy hull slapping down flat onto the sea after a jump: a big wet water impact splash, close, outdoor
heard: A big close-up water impact: a solid low thud as something heavy hits the surface, immediately followed by a wide wet splash and a tail of spray, droplets and sloshing water that decays over about a second. Sounds like a large object dropped flat onto water, recorded close and outdoors.
sounds_like: A person or heavy object belly-flopping into a lake/pool, close mic
problems: The water splash and spray tail are right, but the impact lacks the deep, resonant hull thud (wood/fiberglass slap) the brief wants — the low end is a generic water thump rather than a heavy hull hitting flat. Also may read slightly small/pool-like rather than open sea; no wave wash or sea ambience in the tail to sell the ocean setting. Could work layered under a hull-slap transient.
